annotations.title: Count the small businesses that can do a kind of work

description:
Rule of Two evidence (FAR 19.502-2: set an acquisition aside when at least two responsible
    small businesses can be expected to offer): the small firms, or the 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB or
    WOSB firms, that the government recorded as small on contract actions in an industry over the
    last three fiscal years, at the agency and in the state when given, and that are still
    registered in SAM.gov. Returns the count for each scope (here, the agency anywhere,
    government-wide), the firms with their awards, how the work has been bought (share to small
    businesses and through set-asides, by year), the registered pool, the size standard and
    `text`, the pack ready to send. It counts the record; the contracting officer decides.
